# Vendored box2d-rs 0.0.4

Upstream: <https://github.com/HumMan/box2d-rs>

This copy was carried over from the Rocketpult Rust recreation. It retains the
upstream MIT license in `LICENSE`. The recreation disables the profiling clock
on WebAssembly and suppresses compiler-era warnings. See the project's
`THIRD_PARTY.md` for the vendoring notes. This README supplies the documentation
path declared by the crate's manifest when packaging the local dependency.
